description: Utility class for manipulating and converting columnar data in Spark SQL's vectorized execution engine, including functions for populating column vectors from rows, converting arrays and maps to Java primitives, and creating columnar batches from row iterators.

classes.name: ColumnVectorUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for handling columnar data conversions and batch creation in Spark SQL.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates a ConstantColumnVector with data from an InternalRow at a specified field index.

methods.name: toJavaIntArray
methods.description: Converts a ColumnarArray to a Java int[] array, throwing if nulls are present.

methods.name: toJavaIntMap
methods.description: Converts a ColumnarMap to a Java Map<Integer, Integer>.

methods.name: appendValue
methods.description: Appends a value to a WritableColumnVector based on its DataType, handling various types including primitives, decimal, interval, variant, date, and timestamp.

methods.name: appendValue
methods.description: Appends a value from a Row to a WritableColumnVector for a specific field index, handling nested types like arrays and structs.

methods.name: toBatch
methods.description: Converts an iterator of Rows into a ColumnarBatch with specified schema and memory mode.
